'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male researcher seen "arguing" with another researcher, [[Chellin]] at the Startorch Academy, Freight Zone. After speaking with them, they no longer appear there anymore.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Chellin:''' Can you finally piece together an Exoswarm with all its limbs working?
:'''Passing Roya:''' Wait, what? I don't like the way you put it!

==Dialogue==
;(First time interaction)
:'''Chellin:''' Talking about that "Exostrider Deconstruction" theory again? Can you finally piece together an Exoswarm with all its limbs working?
:'''Passing Roya:''' Wait, what? I don't like the way you put it!
:'''Pelm:''' Just save your breath. With all your talk of "Open the [[Stridergate]]" and "Return to the universe," what have you actually managed to build?
:'''Pelm:''' Oh my... guess you're still struggling to reach the stratosphere.
:'''Chellin:''' And the Exoswarm just scatter the moment they see you. I heard one even kicked you in the head last month. Still recovering, I suppose?
:'''Chellin:''' Hah... do you even have a single propulsion unit that's not using components we reverse-engineered from the Exostrider? Forgetting where your tech comes from is no way to do research!
:'''Josephson:''' Turn off the [[Starstack]] before you argue, will you? The students can hear every word you're saying.
:'''Chellin:''' We aren't arguing, just having a discussion.
:'''Pelm:''' Agreed.
----
;(Second interaction)
:;'''Pelm''' They've really came up with such an algorithm...
:'''Pelm:''' See that? They actually boosted the engine thrust efficiency of the Twin Nova series by almost 20 percent.
:'''Pelm:''' And they even fixed the overheating problem with the Crystallized Energy Cores while they were at it.
:'''Pelm:''' Without that optimization algorithm, the Twin Nova's flight test might've been delayed.
----
;Located at Starward Riseway
:'''Chellin:''' What are you up to? 
:'''Pelm:''' What else? Analyzing the Exostrider's memory module. What about you?
:'''Chellin:''' Tweaking the Twin Nova's engine experiment, of course. Just save the dumb question.
:'''Pelm:''' Hey, is it really so hard to compliment someone else's great work?
:'''Chellin:''' That's easier said than done. Without criticism, praise has no meaning.
:'''Pelm:''' Must you quote aphorisms at me?
:'''Josephson:''' Now... both of you, turn off the Starstack, please...
:'''Chellin:''' We weren't arguing, just having a discussion.
:'''Pelm:''' Agreed.
{{Dialogue End}}
